name: 46064 · Pendleton, IN
findings: ZIP 46064 (Pendleton) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46064 (Pendleton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46064 (Pendleton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
